thread:
Noah: Quick check-in: planning a co-hosted session with ModelOpsWorks on May 12. Goal = practical playbook for shipping LLM features w/ demos + lead capture. Thoughts?
Maya: Love it. Co-host gives credibility for sys-savvy audience. We should split time: 20m playbook, 20m demo, 10m panel.
Liz (Sales): Need a clear qualification flow on the form. Suggested fields: company, team size (dropdown), primary use case (checkboxes), and an "interested in dedicated/private" radio.
Diego: Agree on flow. For the demo, propose two short scenarios: 1) high-throughput chat (batched) 2) secure on-prem fallback. Each should be 5m tops.
Priya: Rehearsal plan: T-7 days tech check, T-2 days full dress (slides + run through + backup video). Can do T-1 day 30m final dry-run.
Sam (Ops): I'll provision a demo namespace and pre-seed sample data. Anyone want a disposable tenant for the on-prem demo?
Noah: Yes please Sam. Also need sample prompts that show cost vs latency trade-offs. Diego can you draft 6 prompts?
Diego: On it. I'll keep 3 short conversational prompts and 3 longer context-aware tasks.
Maya: Marketing deliverables: hero headline, 2 variants of LinkedIn copy, 3 X tweet-length promos, one email invite, and a landing page form. I can draft first pass by Fri.
Liz (Sales): Promo CTA should include "Request follow-up demo" checkbox. For HubSpot routing, add property `webinar_source=cohost-modelops` and hard tag `WBNR-CMH`.
Sam (Ops): HubSpot ingestion snippet (to be used by landing webhook):
Sam (Ops): ```
POST /hubspot/v1/contacts
Body: {"properties": [{"property":"email","value":"{{email}}"},{"property":"webinar_source","value":"cohost-modelops"},{"property":"demo_request","value":"{{demo}}"}]}
```
Priya: Question on recording gating: partner asks to make recording available publicly after 2 weeks. Sales prefers registrants-only forever. Recommend: registrants-only for 30 days, then public. Opinions?
Maya: 30 days sounds fair. We can push an edited highlights clip public after 7 days and full recording after 30.
Noah: Agreed. Also tracking: if someone watches >60% mark, auto-tag as "high-engagement" in HubSpot. Liz can you confirm scoring rule?
Liz (Sales): Confirmed. I'll add a workflow: `if watch_pct >= 60 then add_tag: high-engagement and notify AM`.
Diego: Speakers: @Diego (infrastructure), @Noah (product), @Maya (marketing), Partner: Clara (ModelOpsWorks). Can each confirm slide uploads to Drive by Mon 12pm PT?
Maya: Confirmed — will upload.
Priya: We'll need a 1-slide backup and a short transcript/outline for the captioning vendor. Please add to uploads.
Noah: Who will moderate live Q&A? Prefer partner (Clara) + one Redwood engineer. Maya or Diego volunteer?
Diego: I can co-moderate with Clara, handle infra questions.
Maya: I'll track chat and surface top questions to moderators.
Sam (Ops): Rehearsal checklist I'll run through: 1) mic/video check 2) demo namespace health 3) fallback failover test (throttle hosted -> route to dedicated) 4) recording permissions set
Noah: Promo schedule: email blast 2 weeks out, reminder 3 days out, final reminder 1 hour prior. Social: LinkedIn 10 days out, Twitter cadence 7/4/1 days.
Maya: Draft tweet blurbs: 
Maya: 1) "How do you serve LLMs in production without breaking the bank? Join us + ModelOpsWorks on May 12 for a playbook + demos. Register: [link]"
Maya: 2) "Live demo: watch hosted -> dedicated -> private fallback in action. Real configs, real tradeoffs. Save your spot: [link]"
Maya: 3) "Scaling LLM inference for products: tactics that cut cost and keep latency predictable. Free webinar May 12. [link]"
Liz (Sales): Add a sentence to the email invite about follow-up: "Want a custom cost review? Check the box on registration and we'll reach out."
Priya: Accessibility: we'll enable captions, have 24h caption turnaround for the recording. Also add a quick poll during webinar: 'Primary goal for LLMs' with options: prototyping, customer support, personalization, search.
Diego: For live demo scripts, I'll add short failure scenarios we can trigger: GPU OOM, network latency spike, and a model variant unavailability. Each failure script should have the expected remediation steps listed.
Noah: Any objections to publishing the landing page tomorrow morning? If none, Maya will push and loop in partners for cross-promotion.
Maya: No objections. I'll publish at 9am PT and share the link here.
webinar-bot: Heads up — rehearsal reminders will be posted: T-7 days, T-2 days, T-1 day, and 1 hour prior.
